decoded_text: {"obligations":[{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Everything is measured and recorded in centimeters — no inches anywhere in the live protocol or the log."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Log entries are never deleted; if an entry is wrong, mark it VOID with a one-line reason and leave it in place."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Every alteration ID starts with the prefix GAV followed by a four-digit sequence number, so GAV-0001, GAV-0002 and so on."},{"source_ids":["msg-03"],"text":"Write for our volunteer stitchers — plain language, and any tailoring term of art gets a one-line gloss the first time it appears in a section."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"This production only. Harborside's other fall show, 'Rope Ladder,' keeps its own tracker, and I don't want our document drifting into a company template."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"Rush handling: anything due within 48 hours of a performance is a rush item — tag it RUSH in the status line and float it to the top of the daily pull list."},{"source_ids":["msg-05"],"text":"Approvals: any alteration estimated over $150 in materials or labor goes in as PENDING-PM and can only be marked APPROVED once Ines Duarte, our production manager, initials it. At or under $150, Devon Okafor, my first hand, or I can approve directly."},{"source_ids":["msg-06"],"text":"Dual initials (stitcher plus dresser) on every sub-30-second quick-change completion, and rentals exempted from append-only — returned rentals move to the archive sheet and leave the active log, with the owner-permission scan gating any permanent alteration approval."},{"source_ids":["msg-07"],"text":"Rental exceptions: when a rental ships back, move its entries to a separate rental archive sheet and strike them from the active log. Also, a rental can never be marked APPROVED for a permanent alteration unless a scanned owner-permission note is attached to the entry."},{"source_ids":["msg-09"],"text":"Capture them on the entry. Every alteration entry carries a measurement snapshot — the wearer's bust, waist, and hip in centimeters, taken at the time the alteration is logged."}]}
